text:
From the motionless beloved


My God, I offer you my pain:

It is all I can offer you!

You gave me a love, one single love,

a great love!


Death stole it from me

...and nothing remains to me but my pain.

Accept it, Lord;

It is all I can now offer you!...

translation.title: From the Motionless Beloved...
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the offering of grief as the only remaining gift.
